objective.text: Delay reading attachment bytes until sending when using an Attachment data callback.

difficulty.rationale: Identify the moment data generation occurs instead of assuming declaration eagerly produces bytes.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.source:
<?php

use Illuminate\Mail\Mailables\Attachment;

$reads = 0;

$attachment = Attachment::fromData(function () use (&$reads) {
    $reads++;

    return 'report bytes';
}, 'report.txt');

stem: What is $reads immediately after this declaration, before the attachment is attached to a message?

options.rationale: There is no automatic construction-time validation pass that reads the callback twice.
options.misconception: There is no automatic construction-time validation pass that reads the callback twice.

options.text: An undefined variable because by-reference captures cannot be deferred
options.rationale: The closure retains a valid reference to the variable in this scope.

options.rationale: fromData retains the callback; the bytes are produced when the attachment is materialized for a message.
